title: Asking an AI for salary negotiation advice is a matter of concern: Controlled experimental perturbation of ChatGPT for protected and non-protected group discrimination on a contextual task with no clear ground truth answers
reasoning: The paper conducts an ethical audit of AI systems, specifically focusing on fairness, discrimination, and trustworthiness in the context of salary negotiations. It evaluates the models on socio-ethical dimensions, explicitly discusses the normative implications of AI behavior, and addresses its own epistemological framework for the study.
